cases.supported_conclusion: B1 is non-empty; this check does not establish that its value meets the requested sum.
must_avoid: Treating the passing non-empty check as task correctness.
Requiring every task to add more self-checks.

cases.supported_conclusion: The program's computed value was saved and read back consistently; the sum computation itself remains wrong.
must_avoid: Using agreement with the program's own value as independent proof of correct computation.

cases.supported_conclusion: The readback check usefully detects that the intended value is not available to a data_only reader; retain this targeted check where that property is required.
must_avoid: Discarding readback checks as universally useless.
Claiming that a missing cache proves the formula logic wrong.
Relaxing the task's requirement to retain the formula.

cases.supported_conclusion: The saved B1 value meets the specific A1 + A2 requirement on this input; the check does not establish preservation of unrelated content or formatting.
must_avoid: Refusing to conclude anything even though the specific requirement was checked.
Claiming that unchecked formatting or all task requirements were verified.
